name: Fair Duelist Difficulty
summary: Shorter, deadly fights with 25% less enemy health than Fair, Duelist aggression, and Fair enemy damage and combat stamina costs. Renames Duelist to Fair Duelist. No UE4SS required.
author: oOCamilleOo

file.description: 25% less enemy health than Fair, with Fair enemy damage and combat stamina costs. Includes renamed menu options and updated descriptions. Select Fair Duelist. No UE4SS required.

changelog: Initial Nexus release, combining the development changes.
Keep Duelist enemy health, aggression, action settings and hidden directional indicators.
Use Fair enemy damage and combat stamina costs.
Rename Duelist to Fair Duelist and correct preset, RPG and Action descriptions.
Support independent customization through the existing RPG and Action settings.
